qe: During the 1905 Benaras session of the Indian National Congress, the differences between the Moderates and Extremists came to the fore. What was the central point of contention regarding the Swadeshi and Boycott program?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 1905 के बनारस अधिवेशन के दौरान, नरमपंथियों और गरमपंथियों के बीच मतभेद खुलकर सामने आए। स्वदेशी और बहिष्कार कार्यक्रम के संबंध में विवाद का मुख्य बिंदु क्या था?
o: The Extremists wanted to extend the movement outside Bengal and include a boycott of all government associations, which the Moderates opposed
The Moderates demanded an immediate armed uprising across all northern plains
The Extremists sought a complete structural merger of the Congress with the Dharma Sabha
The Moderates completely refused to pass any resolution condemning Lord Curzon's policies
e: Detailed Explanation: At the 1905 Benaras session, the Extremists wanted to extend the Boycott and Swadeshi movement to regions outside Bengal and include a boycott of government service, law courts, and councils. The Moderates opposed this, wanting to restrict the agitation to Bengal and stick strictly to constitutional methods.

qe: At the Calcutta Congress session of December 1906, who was elected as the compromise President to successfully avert an imminent split between the Moderate and Extremist factions?
qh: दिसंबर 1906 के कलकत्ता कांग्रेस सत्र में, नरमपंथी और गरमपंथी गुटों के बीच एक आसन्न विभाजन को सफलतापूर्वक टालने के लिए समझौते के तहत किसे अध्यक्ष चुना गया था?
o: Dadabhai Naoroji
Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Lala Lajpat Rai
Rashbehari Ghosh
e: Detailed Explanation: In the 1906 Calcutta session, the Extremists pushed for Tilak or Lajpat Rai as president, while the Moderates proposed Dadabhai Naoroji. Because Naoroji was universally respected by all nationalists, his election averted a split for the time being.

qe: The word 'Swaraj' was mentioned for the very first time from the official Congress platform during which annual session, defining the goal as self-government similar to the United Kingdom or its colonies?
qh: आधिकारिक कांग्रेस मंच से पहली बार 'स्वराज' शब्द का उल्लेख किस वार्षिक सत्र के दौरान किया गया था, जिसमें लक्ष्य को यूनाइटेड किंगडम या उसके उपनिवेशों के समान स्वशासन के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया था?
o: The Calcutta session of 1906
The Benaras session of 1905
The Surat session of 1907
The Nagpur proposal of 1907
e: Detailed Explanation: The goal of the Congress was defined as 'swarajya or self-government' like the UK or its colonies (Australia/Canada) for the first time at the Calcutta session of 1906 under Dadabhai Naoroji. However, its exact connotation was not spelt out, leaving room for different interpretations.

qe: Why did the Moderate leadership strongly oppose the Extremist program of widespread passive resistance and council boycotts during the run-up to the Surat split?
qh: सूरज विभाजन की तैयारी के दौरान नरमपंथी नेतृत्व ने व्यापक निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोध और परिषद बहिष्कारों के गरमदलीय कार्यक्रम का कड़ा विरोध क्यों किया?
o: They feared that intense anti-imperialist agitation would be ruthlessly suppressed by the mighty colonial forces, and they saw council reforms as an opportunity for participation
They were legally forced by a decree of the Calcutta High Court to dissolve the Congress infrastructure
They completely supported the implementation of separate electorates for different communities
They aimed to entirely replace vernacular education with English-medium military training
e: Detailed Explanation: The Moderates felt that hasty or radical anti-imperialist agitation would invite ruthless state repression and annoy the ruling Liberals in England. They also saw the upcoming council reforms as a genuine opportunity to realize Indian participation in the administration.

qe: The Extremists wanted the historic 1907 Congress session to be held in Nagpur. Why did the Moderates purposefully shift the venue of the session to Surat?
qh: गरमपंथी चाहते थे कि ऐतिहासिक 1907 का कांग्रेस सत्र नागपुर में आयोजित हो। नरमपंथियों ने जानबूझकर इस सत्र के स्थान को सूरत में क्यों स्थानांतरित कर दिया?
o: To exclude Bal Gangadhar Tilak from the presidency, since a leader from the host province could not become the session president
Because Surat possessed a larger network of British managing agencies to fund the session
To completely avoid a severe outbreak of cholera that had paralyzed the Central Provinces
Because the Government had legally banned any political meetings from taking place in Nagpur
e: Detailed Explanation: Under Congress conventions, a leader from the host province could not preside over that session. Since Surat was in Tilak's home province of Bombay, shifting the venue to Surat effectively disqualified him from the presidency, which was a calculated move by the Moderates.

qe: Who was proposed and backed by the Moderates as the President of the split-ridden Surat session of the Indian National Congress in December 1907?
qh: दिसंबर 1907 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के विभाजनकारी सूरत सत्र के अध्यक्ष के रूप में नरमपंथियों द्वारा किसे प्रस्तावित और समर्थित किया गया था?
o: Rashbehari Ghosh
Aurobindo Ghosh
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Pherozshah Mehta
e: Detailed Explanation: At the Surat session of 1907, the Moderates put forward the name of Rashbehari Ghosh as president and sought to drop the previous resolutions on swadeshi, boycott, and national education, leading to an absolute structural breakdown and split.

qe: Following the Surat split of 1907, the colonial government launched a massive attack on the Extremists. Which of the following sets of repressive laws was brought into force between 1907 and 1911 to check anti-government activity?
qh: 1907 के सूरत विभाजन के बाद, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने गरमपंथियों पर बड़ा हमला किया। 1907 और 1911 के बीच सरकार विरोधी गतिविधियों को रोकने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दमनकारी कानून लागू किया गया था?
o: Seditious Meetings Act, 1907; Indian Newspapers (Incitement to Offences) Act, 1908; and Indian Press Act, 1910
Vernacular Press Act, 1878; and Licensing Regulations Act, 1823
Age of Consent Act, 1891; and Sarda Act, 1930 structural updates
Sikh Gurudwaras Act, 1922; and the Mahad Water Tank Proclamation codes
e: Detailed Explanation: To suppress the leaderless Extremists after the split, the government passed a series of harsh laws between 1907 and 1911, including the Seditious Meetings Act (1907), the Indian Newspapers Act (1908), the Criminal Law Amendment Act (1908), and the Indian Press Act (1910).

qe: In 1897 and again during his major sedition trial in 1909, Lokmanya Tilak was heavily penalized for articles published in his Marathi journal. What was the name of this newspaper?
qh: 1897 में और फिर 1909 में अपने बड़े राजद्रोह के मुकदमे के दौरान, लोकमान्य तिलक को उनकी मराठी पत्रिका में प्रकाशित लेखों के लिए भारी दंड दिया गया था। इस समाचार पत्र का नाम क्या था?
o: Kesari
Maharatta
Sudharak
Darpan
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak used his Marathi weekly newspaper 'Kesari' to express bold political views. His editorials about the Muzaffarpur bomb incident led to his arrest and trial for sedition in 1909.

qe: What severe sentence was awarded to Bal Gangadhar Tilak during his 1909 sedition trial, causing countrywide protests and industrial working-class strikes in Bombay?
qh: 1809 के राजद्रोह के मुकदमे के दौरान बाल गंगाधर तिलक को कौन सी गंभीर सजा सुनाई गई थी, जिसके कारण देशव्यापी विरोध प्रदर्शन हुए और बॉम्बे में औद्योगिक मजदूर वर्ग ने हड़ताल की?
o: Six years' transportation and a fine of Rs 1,000 to Mandalay (Burma) jail
Transportation for life to the Cellular Jail in the Andaman Islands
Eighteen months of simple imprisonment inside the Poona local barracks
An absolute dynamic house arrest restricting his movement to the Bombay municipality
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak was judged guilty of sedition in 1909 and sentenced to six years of transportation and a fine of Rs 1,000. He was sent to the remote fortress prison at Mandalay in Burma, which sparked historic working-class strikes.

qe: The British Secretary of State John Morley implemented a modified three-pronged strategy toward the Indian nationalists. What was the central mechanism of this strategy?
qh: ब्रिटिश राज्य सचिव जॉन मॉर्ले ने भारतीय राष्ट्रवादियों के प्रति एक संशोधित त्रिस्तरीय रणनीति लागू की। इस रणनीति का मुख्य तंत्र क्या था?
o: A strategy of Repression-Conciliation-Suppression designed to isolate the Extremists by placating the Moderates
The complete physical elimination of all intermediate zamindari land revenue collection tiers
A total structural alliance with underground revolutionary outfits to bypass the Congress
The mandatory corporate financing of all newly opened swadeshi textile mills
e: Detailed Explanation: The strategy was designed as 'Carrot and Stick' (Repression-Conciliation-Suppression). The government repressed the Extremists mildly to frighten the Moderates, then placated the Moderates with council reforms to isolate the Extremists. Once isolated, the Extremists were suppressed with full state might, after which the Moderates could be ignored.

qe: In October 1906, a highly influential group of Muslim elites met Viceroy Lord Minto to demand separate electorates. What is this historic event called in modern Indian history?
qh: अक्टूबर 1906 में, मुस्लिम अभिजात वर्ग के एक अत्यधिक प्रभावशाली समूह ने अलग निर्वाचन मंडल (separate electorates) की मांग के लिए वायसराय लॉर्ड मिंटो से मुलाकात की। आधुनिक भारतीय इतिहास में इस ऐतिहासिक घटना को क्या कहा जाता है?
o: The Simla Deputation led by the Agha Khan
The Aligarh Liberal Council led by Sir Syed Ahmed Khan
The Faraizi Revolutionary League led by Dudu Mian
The Dacca Conglomerate organized by Nawab Salimullah
e: Detailed Explanation: In October 1906, a delegation of aristocratic Muslims known as the Simla Deputation, led by the Agha Khan, met Viceroy Minto. They demanded separate electorates for Muslims and political representation in excess of their numerical strength, which laid the groundwork for institutional communal electorates.

qe: The Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, which translated into the Indian Councils Act of 1909, introduced a highly controversial institutional mechanism that deeply damaged national unity. What was this mechanism?
qh: 1909 के मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों, जो 1909 के भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम में परिवर्तित हुए, ने एक अत्यधिक विवादास्पद संस्थागत तंत्र पेश किया जिसने राष्ट्रीय एकता को गहरा नुकसान पहुँचाया। यह तंत्र क्या था?
o: The establishment of separate electorates for Muslims for election to the Central Council
The total legal abolition of all native vernacular media publications across presidencies
The absolute non-cooperation framework barring any Indian from entering the civil services
The direct physical takeover of all village community water solutions by British managing agencies
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Councils Act of 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms) introduced separate electorates for Muslims for the first time in the central legislative council. This institutionalized communal politics and created deep political barriers that checked the growth of national unity.

qe: Under the modified electoral specifications of the Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, how were the non-official elected members of the legislatures chosen?
qh: 1909 के मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों के संशोधित चुनावी विशिष्टताओं के तहत, विधानसभाओं के गैर-आधिकारिक निर्वाचित सदस्यों का चयन कैसे किया जाता था?
o: They were indirectly elected through a multi-tiered system involving local bodies, electoral colleges, and provincial members
They were chosen via an open universal adult franchise tracking system across all provinces
They were handpicked by the executive committee of the All India Kisan Sabha directly
They were selected by running standard competitive examination testing metrics in English
e: Detailed Explanation: The election system under the 1909 Act was highly indirect (described as infiltration through a number of sieves). Local bodies elected an electoral college, which elected provincial legislators, who in turn elected the members of the central Imperial Legislative Council.

qe: Apart from separate electorates, what additional discriminatory electoral privileges were accorded to Muslim voters under the Indian Councils Act of 1909?
qh: पृथक निर्वाचन मंडल के अलावा, भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम 1909 के तहत मुस्लिम मतदाताओं को कौन से अतिरिक्त चुनावी विशेषाधिकार दिए गए थे?
o: Representation in excess of their numerical population strength and lower income qualification thresholds than Hindu voters
The exclusive statutory right to vote on the total annual budget of the Central Council
Complete legal exemption from paying any land revenue or salt taxes across the country
The dynamic right to issue religious decrees (fatwas) against British executive actions
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1909 Reforms granted Muslims representation in excess of their population percentage and kept the income and property qualification threshold for Muslim voters lower than that required for Hindu voters, creating systemic legal disparities.

qe: The Indian Councils Act of 1909 enlarged the functional powers of the legislatures. Which of the following operations were the members now legally authorized to perform?
qh: 1909 के भारतीय परिषद अधिनियम ने विधानसभाओं की कार्यात्मक शक्तियों का विस्तार किया। सदस्यों को अब कानूनी रूप से निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्य करने का अधिकार दिया गया था?
o: Pass resolutions, ask questions and supplementaries, and vote on separate items in the budget
Vote upon and amend the imperial budget as a whole package unconditionally
Overturn any executive decision passed by the Viceroy's executive council directly
Appoint provincial lieutenant governors independent of the British Crown's approval
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1909 reforms expanded the powers of the legislative councils by allowing members to ask supplementary questions, move resolutions, and vote on separate items within the budget, although the budget as a whole could still not be voted upon.

qe: Who holds the historic distinction of being appointed as the very first Indian member to the Viceroy’s Executive Council in 1809 under the provisions of the Morley-Minto Reforms?
qh: मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों के प्रावधानों के तहत 1909 में वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद (Viceroy's Executive Council) में नियुक्त होने वाले पहले भारतीय सदस्य होने का ऐतिहासिक गौरव किसे प्राप्त है?
o: Satyendra Sinha
Rashbehari Ghosh
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Ananda Mohan Bose
e: Detailed Explanation: Satyendra Prasanna Sinha (S.P. Sinha) was appointed as the Law Member to the Viceroy's Executive Council in 1909, becoming the first Indian to enter this high-level executive administrative body.

qe: During the first World War, Indian nationalist leaders launched the Home Rule Movement. What was the primary objective of this coordinated political alliance?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान, भारतीय राष्ट्रवादी नेताओं ने होम रूल आंदोलन शुरू किया था। इस समन्वित राजनीतिक गठबंधन का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: To demand self-government or home rule for all of India within the British Commonwealth through a year-round national alliance
To organize a nationwide violent armed rebellion to completely overthrow the British Raj immediately
To structurally support the collection of wartime revenue surcharges from landless ryots
To enforce the mandatory implementation of English-only educational curriculum across village panchayats
e: Detailed Explanation: Inspired by the Irish Home Rule League, the Indian Home Rule Movement aimed to establish a year-round national alliance to demand self-government (Home Rule) for India within the British Commonwealth, moving away from the Congress's traditional inactive annual-only session approach.

qe: Instead of a single integrated organization, two separate Home Rule Leagues were launched in 1916. Who were the independent leaders who set them up?
qh: 1916 में एक एकल एकीकृत संगठन के बजाय दो अलग-अलग होम रूल लीग शुरू की गईं। इन्हें स्थापित करने वाले स्वतंत्र नेता कौन थे?
o: Balgangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant
Surendranath Banerjea and Ananda Mohan Bose
Gopal Krishna Gokhale and Mahadeo Govind Ranade
Mohammad Ali Jinnah and Motilal Nehru
e: Detailed Explanation: To avoid organizational friction and smooth out personal group differences, two separate Home Rule Leagues were established in 1916: one by Lokmanya Balgangadhar Tilak and the other by the Irish theosophist Annie Besant.

qe: Which global event during the early 20th century exposed the bare propaganda of Western nations and heavily shook the deep-seated myth of white superiority in the minds of the Indian public?
qh: 20वीं शताब्दी की शुरुआत में किस वैश्विक घटना ने पश्चिमी देशों के नग्न प्रचार को उजागर किया और भारतीय जनता के मन में बैठी श्वेत सर्वोच्चता (white superiority) के गहरे मिथक को हिलाकर रख दिया?
o: The First World War
The Russian Revolution of 1905
The Unification of Germany
The American Civil War
e: Detailed Explanation: The outbreak of the First World War (1914–1918) among major European imperialist powers exposed their raw greed and mutual propaganda, which effectively shattered the long-standing myth of white racial superiority and European cultural benevolence in the minds of colonized peoples.

qe: In April 1916, Balgangadhar Tilak formally launched his Indian Home Rule League. Where did he host his first historic Home Rule meeting?
qh: अप्रैल 1916 में, बालगंगाधर तिलक ने औपचारिक रूप से अपनी इंडियन होम रूल लीग शुरू की। उन्होंने अपनी पहली ऐतिहासिक होम रूल बैठक कहाँ आयोजित की थी?
o: Belgaum
Poona
Bombay city
Nagpur
e: Detailed Explanation: Lokmanya Tilak established his Indian Home Rule League in April 1916 and hosted his first historic campaign meeting at Belgaum, setting up his organizational headquarters at Poona.

qe: What specific territorial jurisdiction was mapped out for Balgangadhar Tilak’s Home Rule League, leaving the remaining parts of India to Annie Besant’s League?
qh: बालगंगाधर तिलक की होम रूल लीग के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट क्षेत्रीय अधिकार क्षेत्र तय किया गया था, जिससे भारत के शेष हिस्से एनी बेसेंट की लीग के लिए बच गए?
o: Maharashtra (excluding Bombay city), Karnataka, Central Provinces, and Berar
The Madras Presidency along with the entire Bengal delta plain
The Punjab province, Sindh subdivision, and Delhi municipality exclusively
Bombay city, Gujarat regions, and the United Provinces zones
e: Detailed Explanation: To prevent overlapping work, Tilak's League operated within a strictly defined territorial zone: Maharashtra (specifically excluding Bombay city), Karnataka, the Central Provinces, and Berar. Annie Besant's League covered the rest of India, including Bombay city.

qe: What distinct demands formed the programmatic baseline of Lokmanya Tilak’s Home Rule League branches during their 1916 organizational tours?
qh: 1916 के संगठनात्मक दौरों के दौरान लोकमान्य तिलक की होम रूल लीग शाखाओं की मांगों का मुख्य आधार क्या था?
o: Swarajya, the formation of linguistic states, and education in the vernacular medium
The immediate and complete abolition of the central Imperial Legislative Council
A total ban on the entry of non-Brahmin intermediate castes into local schools
The direct legal nationalization of all foreign-owned jute and cotton textile mills
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak's League advanced clear, popular demands that resonated with the masses: the attainment of Swarajya, the administrative reorganization of provinces on a linguistic basis, and providing school education in vernacular languages.

qe: Annie Besant formally established her All-India Home Rule League in September 1916. Which city served as its central core base, and who was appointed its Organizing Secretary?
qh: एनी बेसेंट ने सितंबर 1916 में अपनी ऑल-इंडिया होम रूल लीग की औपचारिक स्थापना की। किस शहर ने इसके केंद्रीय मुख्य आधार के रूप में कार्य किया, और इसके आयोजन सचिव के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
o: Madras, with George Arundale as Organizing Secretary
Bombay, with Mohammad Ali Jinnah as Organizing Secretary
Calcutta, with Ananda Mohan Bose as Organizing Secretary
Lahore, with Lala Lajpat Rai as Organizing Secretary
e: Detailed Explanation: Annie Besant launched her All-India Home Rule League in September 1916 with its headquarters located in Madras. The structural advancement and organizational work of her league was managed by its organizing secretary, George Arundale.

qe: Which prominent nationalist leader successfully managed and led the high-profile Bombay division branch of Annie Besant’s All-India Home Rule League?
qh: किस प्रमुख राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने एनी बेसेंट की ऑल-इंडिया होम रूल लीग की हाई-प्रोफाइल बॉम्बे डिवीजन शाखा का सफलतापूर्वक प्रबंधन और नेतृत्व किया था?
o: Mohammad Ali Jinnah
Jawaharlal Nehru
Chittaranjan Das
Tej Bahadur Sapru
e: Detailed Explanation: Annie Besant's league attracted brilliant young professionals and disillusioned Moderates across India. The high-prestige Bombay division branch was led and managed by Mohammad Ali Jinnah.

qe: Which international revolution in 1917 provided a powerful added psychological advantage and momentum to the ongoing Home Rule League campaign in India?
qh: 1917 में किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्रांति ने भारत में चल रहे होम रूल लीग अभियान को एक शक्तिशाली मनोवैज्ञानिक लाभ और गति प्रदान की थी?
o: The Russian Revolution
The French Revolution revival
The Chinese Xinhai Revolution
The Italian Nationalist Unification
e: Detailed Explanation: The dramatic success of the Russian Revolution in 1917, which overthrew an autocratic regime, served as an inspiring psychological catalyst for Indian nationalists, boosting the Home Rule League's campaign for self-determination.

qe: Why did certain groups, such as the Anglo-Indians, many non-Brahmins from the South, and a large section of Muslims, consciously choose to stay away from joining the Home Rule League agitations?
qh: एंग्लो-इंडियंस, दक्षिण के कई गैर-ब्राह्मणों और मुसलमानों के एक बड़े हिस्से जैसे कुछ समूहों ने होम रूल लीग आंदोलनों में शामिल होने से बचने का फैसला क्यों किया?
o: They feared that Home Rule would mean the unchecked rule of the high-caste Hindu majority
They were legally prohibited from participating by official decrees of the Federal Court
They were completely opposed to the study of modern sciences or vernacular education
They received massive direct financial subsidies from the Dayal Singh Trust to remain aloof
e: Detailed Explanation: The Home Rule movement faced opposition from certain minority and intermediate groups. Anglo-Indians, southern non-Brahmins, and many Muslims stayed away because they felt that Home Rule under the Congress would establish the political dominance of the high-caste Hindu majority.

qe: In a dramatic gesture of national protest against the arbitrary arrest and internment of Annie Besant and her associates in June 1917, which Indian leader formally renounced his knighthood?
qh: जून 1917 में एनी बेसेंट और उनके सहयोगियों की मनमानी गिरफ्तारी और नजरबंदी के खिलाफ राष्ट्रीय विरोध के एक नाटकीय कदम के रूप में, किस भारतीय नेता ने अपनी नाइटहुड (knighthood) की उपाधि औपचारिक रूप से त्याग दी थी?
o: Sir S. Subramaniya Aiyar
Satyendra Sinha
Madan Mohan Malaviya
Tej Bahadur Sapru
e: Detailed Explanation: The arrest of Annie Besant in June 1917 provoked widespread public outrage. In a powerful gesture of protest against this high-handed administrative repression, Sir S. Subramaniya Aiyar formally renounced his British knighthood.

qe: The British Secretary of State for India issued a famous official statement in August 1917 declaring that the long-term goal of British rule was the progressive realization of responsible government. Who made this statement?
qh: भारत के ब्रिटिश राज्य सचिव ने अगस्त 1917 में एक प्रसिद्ध आधिकारिक बयान जारी किया जिसमें घोषित किया गया कि ब्रिटिश शासन का दीर्घकालिक लक्ष्य जिम्मेदार सरकार की प्रगतिशील प्राप्ति थी। यह बयान किसने दिया था?
o: Montagu
Morley
Minto
Morford
e: Detailed Explanation: In response to the intense political pressure built up by the Home Rule Leagues, the Secretary of State Edwin Montagu issued the historic August 1917 Declaration, which designated the gradual development of self-governing institutions and responsible government as the long-term objective of British rule in India.

qe: A major external factor that caused the Home Rule movement to lose momentum and peter out by 1919 was the departure of Bal Gangadhar Tilak to England. Why did Tilak travel abroad in September 1918?
qh: एक प्रमुख बाहरी कारक जिसके कारण होम रूल आंदोलन की गति धीमी हो गई और 1919 तक समाप्त हो गया, वह बाल गंगाधर तिलक का इंग्लैंड जाना था। सितंबर 1918 में तिलक ने विदेश यात्रा क्यों की थी?
o: In connection with a libel case against Valentine Chirol whose book 'Indian Unrest' branded Tilak as the father of agitational politics
To formally assume the permanent corporate presidentship of the British Committee in London
To file an urgent judicial appeal before the King-in-Council against his Mandalay prison sentence
To negotiate a confidential financial grant package directly with the British Cabinet ministers
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak traveled to England in September 1918 to pursue a civil libel suit against the British journalist Valentine Chirol. Chirol's highly biased book, 'Indian Unrest', had branded Tilak as the primary instigator and 'father of Indian unrest', leaving the Home Rule League leaderless at a critical juncture.

qe: What profound tactical shift in the national freedom struggle pushed the short-lived Home Rule movement onto the sidelines by 1919?
qh: राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्रता संघर्ष में किस गहरे रणनीतिक बदलाव ने 1919 तक अल्पकालिक होम रूल आंदोलन को हाशिए पर धकेल दिया?
o: Mahatma Gandhi’s fresh, transformative mass approach to the freedom struggle began catching the popular imagination of the people
The complete administrative takeover of all local boards by the orthodox factions of the Dharma Sabha
The total legal nationalization of all vernacular media operations across the Punjab province
A sudden absolute drop in international market price inflation parameters globally
e: Detailed Explanation: By 1919, the Home Rule movement had declined. This was because Mahatma Gandhi's newly introduced methods of mass non-violent Satyagraha captured the imagination of the Indian public, channeling their energies into a larger mass movement that pushed older institutional leagues to the sidelines.

qe: In 1920, Mahatma Gandhi formally accepted the presidentship of the All India Home Rule League. What did he subsequently change the organization’s name to?
qh: 1920 में, महात्मा गांधी ने औपचारिक रूप से ऑल इंडिया होम रूल लीग की अध्यक्षता स्वीकार की। बाद में उन्होंने संगठन का नाम बदलकर क्या कर दिया?
o: Swarajya Sabha
Harijan Sangh
Bahishkrit Sabha
Satyashodhak Front
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1920, Mahatma Gandhi assumed the leadership of the All India Home Rule League. He systematically decentralized its structure and changed its name to 'Swarajya Sabha', before the organization formally merged into the Indian National Congress a year later.

qe: From the perspective of long-term organizational value, what critical positive gain did the Home Rule Movement deliver to the mass phase of the Indian national struggle?
qh: दीर्घकालिक संगठनात्मक मूल्य के दृष्टिकोण से, होम रूल आंदोलन ने भारतीय राष्ट्रीय संघर्ष के जन चरण (mass phase) को कौन सा महत्वपूर्ण सकारात्मक लाभ प्रदान किया?
o: It successfully shifted emphasis from the educated elite to the masses and created a vital organizational link between the town and the country
It forced the absolute legal separation of the judicial high court benches from central executive oversight
It completely eliminated the dependency of local industries on foreign-owned managing agencies
It successfully enforced a flat-rate tax system that fully exempted wealthy landlords from state duties
e: Detailed Explanation: The Home Rule movement was a turning point. It marked a clear transition from the elite, deliberative politics of the early Congress to a mass movement, expanding political awareness into new regions and creating a crucial organizational link between urban towns and rural countryside.

qe: A geographical survey charts a precise right-angled triangular matrix path. A team vehicle travels 24 km North from base O, and then shifts orientation to move 10 km East to reach checkpoint C. Find the direct straight-line distance from O to C.
qh: एक कार बेस O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 10 किमी जाकर चेकपॉइंट C पर पहुँचती है। O से C की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 26 km
34 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This movement forms a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs of 24 km and 10 km. The direct straight-line distance is the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 10^2} = \sqrt{576 + 100} = \sqrt{676} = \mathbf{26\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological survey of an aquatic ecosystem mapping environmental parameters, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of a shallow polluted lake is 32,000 units and the measured Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 12,000 units, calculate the energy lost during community metabolic respiration (R).
qh: पर्यावरणीय मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक जलीय पारितंत्र के जैविक सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक उथली प्रदूषित झील की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 32,000 इकाइयाँ है और मापी गई शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) 12,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
44,000 units
15,000 units
24,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the foundational ecological productivity balance equation: $NPP = GPP - R$, we isolate the value for respiration losses: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the values: $R = 32,000 - 12,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: The historic reunion of the Moderate and Extremist factions took place at which annual session of the Indian National Congress in 1916, heavily influenced by the background work of Tilak and Annie Besant?
qh: नरमपंथियों और गरमपंथियों का ऐतिहासिक पुनर्मिलन 1916 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस वार्षिक सत्र में हुआ था, जो तिलक और एनी बेसेंट के पृष्ठभूमि कार्यों से अत्यधिक प्रभावित था?
o: The Lucknow session of 1916
The Surat session of 1907
The Calcutta session of 1906
The Bombay session of 1915
e: Detailed Explanation: The organizational pressure and mass awakening generated by the Home Rule Leagues directly facilitated a reconciliation. Under the joint efforts of Tilak and Annie Besant, the historic Moderate-Extremist reunion was achieved at the Lucknow session of the Congress in 1916, reviving the organization's nationalist efficacy.

qe: During the run-up to the historic Surat Split, a program of wide 'Passive Resistance' was advocated by the Extremists. What did this strategy aim to achieve according to their political philosophy?
qh: ऐतिहासिक सूरत विभाजन की तैयारी के दौरान, गरमपंथियों द्वारा व्यापक 'निष्क्रिय प्रतिरोध' (Passive Resistance) के कार्यक्रम की वकालत की गई थी। उनके राजनीतिक दर्शन के अनुसार इस रणनीति का उद्देश्य क्या हासिल करना था?
o: To make the colonial administration under present conditions impossible by an organized refusal to cooperate with British commerce or officialdom
To petition the British Crown to permanently expand the advisory powers of the central legislative council
To secure separate judicial high court benches managed exclusively by European judges across all districts
To establish high-cost private banking centers managed by the elite urban-dwelling zamindars
e: Detailed Explanation: The Extremist passive resistance doctrine focused on systematic non-cooperation. By boycotting government schools, courts, services, and local bodies, they aimed to orchestrate an organized refusal to assist colonial administration, making it impossible for the British bureaucracy to function.

qe: Why did the historic joint session of the Indian National Congress in London, originally planned for 1892 to campaign for reforms directly before the British public, fail to materialize?
qh: लंदन में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का ऐतिहासिक संयुक्त सत्र, जो मूल रूप से 1892 के लिए ब्रिटिश जनता के सामने सीधे सुधारों के लिए अभियान चलाने की योजना थी, क्यों अमली जामा पहनाने में विफल रहा?
o: It was permanently postponed and never revived due to the onset of the British general elections of 1891
The colonial judiciary passed a direct decree declaring the entire Congress body illegal
The Moderate leadership completely refused to allocate any funds for international campaigns
A severe out-break of plague had paralyzed all transport operations crossing the maritime trade routes
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1890, the Congress decided to hold a historic national session in London in 1892 to leverage British public men. However, owing to the sudden scheduling and political changes of the British general elections of 1891, the proposal had to be postponed and was never revived in later years.

qe: John Morley, the Secretary of State for India, recorded his candid apprehensions regarding judicial crackdowns in a famous letter to the Governor of Bombay. What did he state regarding the trial of Tilak?
qh: भारत के राज्य सचिव जॉन मॉर्ले ने बॉम्बे के गवर्नर को लिखे एक प्रसिद्ध पत्र में न्यायिक कार्रवाई के संबंध में अपनी स्पष्ट आशंकाएं दर्ज की थीं। तिलक के मुकदमे के संबंध में उन्होंने क्या कहा था?
o: The mischief of the trial and condemnation of Tilak would be greater than if you left him alone
The immediate transportation of Tilak would permanently eliminate all nationalist disaffection in Punjab
The judicial bench must enforce a progress toward separate electorates to placate the Extremists
Tilak should be provided an absolute pardon under the explicit guidelines of Article 72
e: Detailed Explanation: John Morley, a liberal British politician, recognized that severe political trials often backfired by creating martyrs. In a private letter to Sydenham (Governor of Bombay), he warned that the political mischief and popular backlash caused by convicting and condemning Tilak would prove far greater than leaving him alone.

qe: In his famous articles published in 'Kesari' regarding the Muzaffarpur bomb incident, what core corrective measure did Lokmanya Tilak advocate to permanently stop the emergence of revolutionary violence in India?
qh: मुजफ्फरपुर बम कांड के संबंध में 'केसरी' में प्रकाशित अपने प्रसिद्ध लेखों में, लोकमान्य तिलक ने भारत में क्रांतिकारी हिंसा के उभरने को स्थायी रूप से रोकने के लिए किस मुख्य सुधारात्मक उपाय की वकालत की थी?
o: Making a definitive beginning towards the grant of rights of Swarajya to the people
The complete administrative replacement of vernacular schools with English-medium institutes
The strict mandatory implementation of the Seditious Meetings Act across all districts
Enforcing an absolute corporate land revenue tax exemption for wealthy urban merchants
e: Detailed Explanation: Tilak argued that political violence was a symptom of misrule. He wrote that the real and effective means of stopping bomb out-breaks did not lie in state repression, but in addressing the root cause by making a genuine beginning toward granting the rights of Swarajya (self-government) to the Indian public.

qe: The 'Simla Deputation' of October 1906, which successfully petitioned Viceroy Lord Minto for separate communal electorates, was led by which prominent figure?
qh: अक्टूबर 1906 के 'शिमला प्रतिनिधिमंडल' (Simla Deputation), जिसने अलग सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचन मंडल के लिए वायसराय लॉर्ड मिंटो को सफलतापूर्वक याचिका दी थी, का नेतृत्व किस प्रमुख व्यक्ति ने किया था?
o: The Agha Khan
Nawab Salimullah of Dacca
Nawab Mohsin-ul-Mulk
Mirza Ghulam Ahmad
e: Detailed Explanation: The elite Muslim delegation that met Lord Minto at Simla in October 1906 to demand specialized communal safeguards and representation in excess of their numerical strength was formally organized and led by the Agha Khan.

qe: According to the precise mathematical mapping of the central Imperial Legislative Council under the Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909, how many total members were designated, and how many seats were explicitly reserved for Muslims under separate electorates?
qh: 1909 के मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों के तहत केंद्रीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल के सटीक गणितीय मानचित्रण के अनुसार, कुल कितने सदस्य नामित किए गए थे, और पृथक निर्वाचन मंडल के तहत मुसलमानों के लिए कितनी सीटें विशेष रूप से आरक्षित थीं?
o: A total of 69 members, with 8 seats reserved for Muslims under separate electorates
A total of 54 members, with 12 seats reserved for Muslims under separate electorates
A total of 72 members, with 24 seats reserved for Muslims under separate electorates
A total of 31 members, with 5 seats reserved for Muslims under separate electorates
e: Detailed Explanation: As documented by historians like Sumit Sarkar, the 1909 Act fixed the total membership of the central Imperial Legislative Council at 69. Out of these, 37 were officials (ensuring an official majority), and of the remaining non-officials, exactly 8 seats were reserved for Muslims under separate electorates.

qe: The constitutional reforms of 1909 introduced parliamentary forms and debates within the councils, but failed to concede any actual ministerial responsibility. What negative consequence did this systemic mismatch produce?
qh: 1909 के संवैधानिक सुधारों ने परिषदों के भीतर संसदीय रूपों और बहसों की शुरुआत की, लेकिन किसी वास्तविक मंत्रिस्तरीय जिम्मेदारी को स्वीकार करने में विफल रहे। इस प्रणालीगत बेमेल ने कौन सा नकारात्मक परिणाम पैदा किया?
o: It sometimes led to thoughtless and irresponsible criticism of the government by members who held no administrative stakes
It forced all popular native leaders to voluntarily resign and join the underground revolutionary phase
It caused a sudden absolute drop in the numerical density of the central official majority
It permanently blocked any independent discussion or debate regarding local primary education
e: Detailed Explanation: Because the Morley-Minto framework introduced parliamentary mechanisms (like asking supplementaries and debating items) without granting any actual executive or legislative responsibility to Indian members, it created a structural vacuum that sometimes resulted in thoughtless or irresponsible criticism, as members held no administrative stakes in running the departments.

qe: Despite overall limitations, which brilliant Moderate leader masterfully utilized the council debates under the 1909 Act to demand universal primary education and attack the plight of indentured labor?
qh: समग्र सीमाओं के बावजूद, किस शानदार नरमपंथी नेता ने 1909 के अधिनियम के तहत परिषद की बहसों का कुशलतापूर्वक उपयोग सार्वभौमिक प्राथमिक शिक्षा की मांग करने और गिरमिटिया श्रम की दुर्दशा पर हमला करने के लिए किया?
o: Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Satyendra Sinha
Pherozshah Mehta
Rashbehari Ghosh
e: Detailed Explanation: Gopal Krishna Gokhale stood out for his constructive use of the expanded legislative council opportunities. He delivered landmark speeches demanding universal primary education, drawing urgent public attention to the plight of Indian indentured laborers working in South Africa, and attacking state repression.

qe: The historic Montford Report and subsequent constitutional reviews heavily criticized the Morley-Minto reforms. What was their evaluation regarding the 1909 structural updates?
qh: ऐतिहासिक मोंटफोर्ड रिपोर्ट (Montford Report) और उसके बाद की संवैधानिक समीक्षाओं ने मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों की तीखी आलोचना की। 1909 के संरचनात्मक अपडेट के संबंध में उनका मूल्यांकन क्या था?
o: The reforms of 1909 afforded no answer, and could afford no answer to Indian problems
The reforms successfully established a robust parliamentary responsible government in India
The 1909 Act fully satisfied the absolute constitutional baseline demands of the Moderates
The separate electorates successfully unified the traditional social strata of the country
e: Detailed Explanation: The official Montford Report (Montagu-Chelmsford Report) later concluded that the Indian Councils Act of 1892 and its 1909 updates provided no real answer to India's expanding political aspirations, as they merely offered a shadow of representation without any transfer of democratic power.

qe: In his analytical evaluation of the 1909 reforms, which national leader noted that separate electorates created a political barrier that isolated communities and acted like a canker corrupting the entire system?
qh: 1909 के सुधारों के अपने विश्लेषणात्मक मूल्यांकन में, किस राष्ट्रीय नेता ने उल्लेख किया कि अलग निर्वाचन मंडलों ने एक राजनीतिक बाधा पैदा की जिसने समुदायों को अलग कर दिया और पूरे सिस्टम को भ्रष्ट करने वाले कैंसर (canker) की तरह काम किया?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru
Mahatma Gandhi
Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Subhas Chandra Bose
e: Detailed Explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru severely criticized the introduction of communal electorates under the Morley-Minto Reforms, observing that it built an artificial political barrier isolating Muslims from the rest of India and acted like a corrupting canker affecting the entire structure of social and political life.

qe: What specific judicial outcome occurred regarding the legal case instituted by the Madras provincial administration against Bal Gangadhar Tilak during his Home Rule campaign?
qh: होम रूल अभियान के दौरान मद्रास प्रांतीय प्रशासन द्वारा बाल गंगाधर तिलक के खिलाफ शुरू किए गए कानूनी मामले के संबंध में क्या विशिष्ट न्यायिक परिणाम सामने आया था?
o: The case was rescinded and thrown out by the High Court
He was immediately sentenced to another six years of transportation to Mandalay
He was legally forced to pay a flat monetary fine of Rs 5,000 to the Crown treasury
The case resulted in the permanent forfeiture of his registered journal 'Maharatta'
e: Detailed Explanation: In an attempt to suppress his expanding anti-imperialist campaign, the local government instituted a legal case against Tilak. However, this administrative action was ultimately rescinded and thrown out by the High Court, marking a significant legal victory for the Home Rule agitators.

qe: In June 1917, the colonial government arrested Annie Besant and her close associates. Which two dynamic leaders were interned alongside her, sparking nationwide protests?
qh: जून 1917 में, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने एनी बेसेंट और उनके करीबी सहयोगियों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया। देशव्यापी विरोध प्रदर्शनों को जन्म देते हुए उनके साथ किन दो गतिशील नेताओं को नजरबंद किया गया था?
o: B.P. Wadia and George Arundale
Subramania Siva and Chidambaram Pillai
Motilal Nehru and Jawaharlal Nehru
Ananda Mohan Bose and Kumaran Asan
e: Detailed Explanation: In a high-handed bid to crush the Home Rule agitation in Madras, the local bureaucracy arrested Annie Besant in June 1917 along with her key organizational lieutenants, B.P. Wadia and George Arundale.

qe: The British Secretary of State Edwin Montagu recorded a sarcastic comment regarding the strategic failure of interning Mrs. Besant, comparing the government's action to which mythological event?
qh: ब्रिटिश भारत के राज्य सचिव एडविन मोंटेग्यू ने श्रीमती बेसेंट को नजरबंद करने की रणनीतिक विफलता के संबंध में एक व्यंग्यात्मक टिप्पणी दर्ज की, जिसमें सरकार की कार्रवाई की तुलना किस पौराणिक घटना से की गई थी?
o: Shiva cutting his wife into fifty-two pieces only to discover that he had fifty-two wives
The absolute containment of all active localized structural and multi-layered entities
The spontaneous thermodynamic generation of infinite secondary heat blocks
The linear disintegration of all prime prime factor factor cyclicity matrices
e: Detailed Explanation: Critiquing the clumsy administrative repression deployed by the Government of India, Edwin Montagu sarcastically noted in his private papers that interning Mrs. Besant backfired completely, comparing it to the myth of Shiva cutting his wife into fifty-two pieces only to find himself dealing with fifty-two wives, as her arrest created fifty-two new centers of agitation across the country.

qe: What specific internal ideological split and vacillation heavily contributed to the rapid fading out and decline of Annie Besant's Home Rule League by 1919?
qh: किस विशिष्ट आंतरिक वैचारिक विभाजन और हिचकिचाहट ने 1919 तक एनी बेसेंट की होम रूल लीग के तेजी से समाप्त होने और पतन में भारी योगदान दिया था?
o: The announcement of the Montagu-Chelmsford reforms in July 1918, which divided the nationalist ranks, causing Besant to vacillate over response techniques
The complete physical structural destruction of all her registered printing presses by a magistrate's order
The immediate statutory merger of her entire league infrastructure with the orthodox Dharma Sabha
A total structural drop in the baseline membership enrollment fees across all provincial divisions
e: Detailed Explanation: The publication of the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms proposal in July 1918 created serious rifts within the nationalist movement. Annie Besant herself vacillated heavily over whether to accept or reject the reforms and became ambivalent about utilizing passive resistance, which confused her followers and accelerated the decline of her league.

qe: In 1809, the Secretary of State John Morley clarified his definitive personal views regarding the ultimate target destination of his constitutional updates. What did he state regarding a parliamentary government for India?
qh: 1909 में, राज्य सचिव जॉन मॉर्ले ने अपने संवैधानिक सुधारों के अंतिम लक्ष्य के संबंध में अपने स्पष्ट व्यक्तिगत विचार स्पष्ट किए। भारत के लिए एक संसदीय सरकार के संबंध में उन्होंने क्या कहा था?
o: He was completely against the introduction of parliamentary or responsible government in India, stating he would have nothing to do with it if it led there
He demanded the immediate, absolute establishment of a sovereign democratic adult franchise system across all presidencies
He opined that India should be given dominion status identical to Canada within the next five years
He advocated for the complete subordination of the Viceroy to a joint council composed entirely of non-official Indians
e: Detailed Explanation: John Morley held a classic conservative colonial view. He explicitly stated before the British Parliament that his council updates were by no means intended to establish a parliamentary system in India, asserting that if these reforms led directly or indirectly to a responsible parliamentary framework, he would have nothing at all to do with it.
